title: 02 · Bill approvals · Fennick
strengths: The consequence comes before the decision: an 'If you approve' ledger on Operating ••4410 ($63,904.52 − $15,277.75 − $7,418.60 = $41,208.17 left on Oct 20) and the named policy 'Over $5,000: needs CFO approval'

A queue that reads like a shipped AP tool: tabs with counts (Draft 3 / To approve 14 / Scheduled 22 / Paid 318), two-line rows with mono invoice numbers, '1/2 approved' with progress pips, quiet inline ✓/×, and a total that matches the 14 rows ($92,663.95)
After the decision the toast says what happens next ('$3,912.08 pays on Oct 17 from Operating ••4410') with Undo; the ⌘↵ shortcut sits in the Approve tooltip, not in a footer
One forest-green accent; red only on '2 days overdue' and the Reject tint
slop_signals: Four transients staged at once: open drawer, selected row, the Undo toast over the list, and a hover tooltip ('Approve and schedule payment ⌘↵') covering the comment field
The toast hides the 'Brightline Telecom' row's amount and approvals ('$412.36' is cut)
fixes: Drop the hover tooltip from the main frame; keep either the toast or the drawer focus, not both over content
Make the Harlow toast pay on a business day (Fri Oct 16 or Mon Oct 19)
Change 'Waiting for you, CFO · 5 days' to 4 days (Dana approved Oct 10, 9:03 AM; today is Oct 14)
Rename Wrenfield Water Co. (Sounding's workspace is Wrenfield Pay) and Quillon Software (the mobile approvals app is called Quillon)

references.what: List stays visible, drawer with large amount, mini timeline, Approve/Decline/More, GL code; ours adds the balance-after ledger and policy reason
Drawer with Reject split button and Approve in a sticky footer; ours matches and states the consequence
Bills tabs with counts (Draft/Approve/Ready/Paid); ours has the same tab model with more exact data

fixed: Harlow toast pays on Fri, Oct 16 (Oct 17 is a Saturday); it stays inside '6 bills scheduled before Oct 20' and 'Scheduled 22', so no balance changes ($41,208.17 re-checked)
'Waiting for you, CFO' is 4 days (budget owner approved Sat Oct 10, today Wed Oct 14)

One temporary state per frame: main frame is the review drawer only; the toast is shot-toast.png (?state=toast) and the Approve hover tooltip is shot-tooltip.png (?state=tooltip)
